rationale: Identity verification was done correctly (full name + zip matched one user). However, there were multiple policy violations: (1) The agent changed the shipping address on pending order #W6729841 without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. (2) For the watch modification in #W4219264, the agent did get explicit confirmation to change silicone to metal with white dial, but then used a new item variant (ID 2407258246) that was not shown as available in the product details; only metal/black and silicone/white appeared, so the metal/white choice was unsupported, constituting fabricated/unsupported information. (3) For the air purifier exchange on delivered order #W3445693, the agent executed the exchange without first confirming the exact change and any price difference with the user. These constitute writes without required confirmation and reliance on an unavailable variant, failing the pass bar.
